description: Look up a bot's full public trust profile (use check_payment instead when you are about to pay a wallet): trust_level (unknown/caution/fair/good/excellent), score (for a registry bot, 0-100: how strong its public record is, with the parts it is made of under rating), the reasons, and its proven identities. Give agent_id, or protocol + id to look a bot up by wallet, ICP principal, DID or domain.

protocol.description: Or: icp, eth, erc8004, did, web_bot_auth.

name: check_trust
